name: MenuPricer
serviceType: AI-powered restaurant menu pricing and food cost calculator
description: MenuPricer calculates the correct selling price for a menu item from just a dish name. AI drafts an ingredient cost estimate, which the user corrects, and MenuPricer returns food cost percentage, gross margin, and three pricing tiers (Budget, Standard, Premium), plus delivery-platform-adjusted pricing.

capabilities.name: AI ingredient cost estimation
capabilities.output: A draft ingredient list with typical quantities and estimated costs

capabilities.name: Menu price calculation
capabilities.input: Ingredient costs, labor %, overhead %, packaging cost, target food cost %
capabilities.output: Three pricing tiers (Budget, Standard, Premium) with food cost % and gross margin per tier

capabilities.name: Delivery platform pricing offset
capabilities.input: Base menu price, delivery platform (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub)
capabilities.output: Delivery-adjusted price that accounts for platform commission (15-30%) and payment processing (~2.9%)

capabilities.name: PDF export
capabilities.output: Branded PDF for a single dish's cost breakdown or the full menu

capabilities.name: Recipe and menu history
capabilities.description: Cloud sync of saved dishes, recipes, and pricing history across devices when signed in
